responsibility: Implements the Cygwin-specific target hooks used only by the D front end. It registers D builtin version identifiers for the Cygwin/Windows/Newlib environment, answers D `__traits(getTargetInfo)` queries such as the object format (`coff`), and sets the D target hook that treats templates as always COMDAT, thereby connecting the generic D frontend to Cygwin PE/COFF target properties.
